name: Hodesh
title: Shaharaim's wife from the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Hodesh was a woman from the tribe of Benjamin who married Shaharaim after he had sent away his former wives Hushim and Baara. She bore him several sons in the land of Moab. She is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Marriage with Shaharaim
keyEvents.description: Shaharaim sent away his wives Hushim and Baara, and took Hodesh as a wife in the land of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Mother of seven sons
keyEvents.description: Hodesh bore to Shaharaim the sons Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These became heads of families in Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Role of the family heads
keyEvents.description: The sons of Hodesh were counted as heads of their families and played a role in the genealogical history of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Hodesh is mentioned as part of the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, which was important for preserving the tribe's identity and inheritance rights.
